title: P15.9-B5.3: /app/missions* Mission Operations + Task Entry + Mission Detail (canonical reads)
description: P15.9-B5.3 R1+R2 — R1: lineage provenance (bound_open_id → work_open_binding.open_id → work-item → objective), preview epoch/input pinning, detail collection validation, identity-pinned mutations/files. R2-A: busy is a per-request counter — a stale request clears only its own slot, invalidating an obsolete preview can never wedge Task Entry; confirm POSTs are single-flight via confirmFlight ref; input change during an in-flight confirm surfaces honest unknown/committed outcome (no silent duplicate, no retries). R2-B: lineage work-items evidence validated envelope+rows (null/{}/wrong-business → fail closed, unproven note, backlink omitted; other sections unaffected). R2-C: strict preview task structure — nonempty task_key + required_capabilities/depends_on as arrays of strings; missing/null never coerced to []; malformed preview → INVALID_PREVIEW, no Confirm, zero confirm POSTs; genuine empty arrays still valid. UI-only; no backend/schema/dependency changes.
